## Overview

The architecture of Arcee AI: Trinity Large Thinking is designed to handle a wide range of tasks, including text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization. With its capabilities in text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs, it offers a versatile solution for developers.
